<thought>From the 13C NMR data, peaks in the typical methyl region are at 58.70 ppm (O‑CH₃) and 26.40 ppm (alkyl CH₃). The other upfield peaks (36.40 ppm) are more consistent with methylene or tertiary carbons, not methyls. Therefore the molecule contains two distinct methyl groups.</thought>
